inlines.v: DEVOUT, adjective [Latin See Devote.] 1. Yielding a solemn and reverential attention to God in religious exercises, particularly in prayer. We must be constant and devout in the worship of God. 2. Pious; devoted to religion; religious. Simeon was a just man and devout Luke 2:25. DEVOUT men carried Stephen to his burial. Acts 8:2. 3. Expressing devotion or piety; as, with eyes devout 4. Sincere; solemn; earnest; as, you have my devout wishes for your safety. DEVOUT, noun A devotee. [Not used.]
